basic_details.job_title: NRLM Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka has opened 1 post of Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods at Bangarapet taluka, Kolar district, with a salary of 25000. The post needs an M.Sc. (Agri) or B.Sc. (Agri) and allied sciences of the farm sector, or any other Master degree, with 1, 3 or 5 years of field level work experience respectively. Applications opened on 27 November 2026 and close on 12 December 2026; candidates sign in to their account on the recruitment portal to apply. The age limit is 18 to 45 years.

how_to_apply: The notice asks candidates to submit the application before the deadline, 12 December 2026. To apply, sign in to an existing account or create a free account on the recruitment portal, then use the Sign In to Apply option on the job page. The notice names no documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka's Farm Livelihoods Post
content_sections.text: The notice is a job opening listed under NRLM Karnataka for the Kolar district, Bangarapet taluka. The post works on farm livelihoods activities at block level and supports Mahila Kisan, with coordination across block and cluster level activities and with district and state authorities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post of Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods needs one of the following qualification and experience combinations: M.Sc. (Agri) and allied sciences of farm sector with minimum 01 years of field level work experience in relevant field; or B.Sc. (Agri) and allied sciences of farm sector with minimum 03 years of field level work experience in relevant field; or Any other Master degree with minimum 05 years of field level work experience in farm livelihoods or relevant field. The age limit is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 45 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods Job Description
content_sections.text: Implementation of farm livelihoods related activities at block level in all aspects of Farm livelihoods. Supporting Mahila Kisan in all aspects of Farm livelihoods. Maintaining coordination within Block and Cluster level activities Farm livelihoods. Coordination with other line departments for Convergence at block level. Submission of periodical reports as per the instructions of district and state authorities. Monitoring and support for the activities of the farm livelihoods CRPS through regular field visits. Identify and document best practices in farm livelihoods initiatives. Ensuring data collection and entry into MIS for monitoring and evaluation of farm livelihoods activities. Support the all activities under Farm Livelihoods in development of protocols, package of practices for organic farming. Also, facilitate workshops consultations necessary for developing the same. Identifying institutional buyers / local buyers, conducting buyer seller meets. Any other tasks assigned by the higher authorities of the Mission.

To apply, sign in to an existing account or create a free account on the recruitment portal, then use the Sign In to Apply option on the job page. The notice names no documents to attach.
